# Runtime Profiles and Startup {#sec-runtime}

## Profiles

`dr_support/app.py` builds one of three applications. Misconfiguration raises at startup; it never falls back silently.

| `APP_PROFILE` | Required `MODEL_RUNTIME` | Surface | Used by |
|:--------------|:-------------------------|:--------|:--------|
| `review` (default) | `remote` | Review API + `/app/` + `/ui/`; no sample or demo fixtures; model calls go to `REMOTE_MODEL_URL` | Clinician workstation (`START.cmd`) |
| `model_api` | `local` | `/health`, `/v1/models`, `/v1/predict/dr`, `/v1/predict/lesions`; CUDA enforced unless `DR_SUPPORT_RELAX_DEVICE=1` | GPU host (`start.sh`) |
| `full` | `local` | Both surfaces merged, with synthetic fixtures and public samples; CPU allowed | Local demos and development only |

: Runtime profiles. {#tbl-profiles tbl-colwidths="[18,20,40,22]"}

`dr_support.api:app` is a separate legacy entry point used by the root UI smoke test (`tests/ui.test.cjs`). It does **not** apply the profile invariants and it includes the synthetic fixture and the public samples.

## Workstation startup (`SETUP.cmd` -> `START.cmd`)

`SETUP.cmd` is the one-time provisioning owner. It bootstraps per-user `uv`
when needed, installs the supported Python 3.12 toolchain, runs `uv sync`,
selects system Node.js or the ignored no-admin fallback, installs the root and
frontend lockfiles, and builds `frontend/dist/`.

`START.cmd` is the daily runtime owner. It requires the project environment and
frontend dependencies to already exist, reuses them, and rebuilds only when the
tracked frontend source or lockfile signature is stale. It never reinstalls
dependencies. It sets `APP_PROFILE=review` and `MODEL_RUNTIME=remote`, then runs
`python -m dr_support.run` on `127.0.0.1:8000`. `OPEN_APP.cmd` opens the app or
delegates to `START.cmd`; `STOP.cmd` stops only the recorded repository process.

At startup, `WorkspaceManager` opens the catalog
(`DR_SUPPORT_WORKSPACE_CATALOG`, default `local-state/bridge/workspaces.sqlite`).
It then opens the active Workspace's review DB, or the fallback DB
(`DR_SUPPORT_STATE`, default `local-state/bridge/reviews.sqlite`), and scans the
active input folder once.

`REMOTE_MODEL_URL` and the optional `REMOTE_MODEL_TOKEN` come from the process environment. The connection can also be tested and saved at runtime through **Settings → Model connection** (`/v1/model-connection*`). The token is held in process memory only and is never returned by the API.

## Model-server setup and startup (GPU host)

Scripts are in `scripts/model-server/`.

| Step | Script | Network | Result |
|:-----|:-------|:--------|:-------|
| One-time setup | `setup.sh` | Online | Creates `.venv`, installs `.[models,dicom]`, runs `python -m dr_support.setup_models --model all --smoke`, clones pinned sources, downloads checkpoints, verifies hashes, runs synthetic smoke inference, prints `READY`. |
| Normal start | `start.sh` | None needed | Sets `APP_PROFILE=model_api`, `MODEL_RUNTIME=local`, `INFERENCE_DEVICE=cuda:0`, `HOST=0.0.0.0`, `PORT=7860`, `WORKERS=1`, `MODEL_REQUIRE_VERIFIED_ASSETS=1`, runs `setup_models --verify` (read-only), then `dr_support.run`. Missing or modified assets fail closed. |
| Health | `healthcheck.sh` | LAN | Calls `/health` and `/v1/models`; fails unless health reports `PASS`. |
| Service | `sudo ./install-service.sh` | None | Installs `deployment/dr-support-model-api.service` (user `drsupport`, `/opt/dr-support-screening-poc`, `/etc/dr-support/model-server.env`). |

: Model server lifecycle. {#tbl-modelserver tbl-colwidths="[16,20,12,52]"}

Pinned identities: RETFound revision and `WEIGHT_SHA256` in `dr_support/providers/retfound.py`; PRISM-DR revision in `providers/prism.py`; the PRISM archive and per-fold weight hashes in `providers/prism_assets.json`. Changing any of them is a model-provenance change (see `AGENTS.md`).
